title: Mexican Women Denounce Their Torture by israel
author: Carolina Gómez Mena
content:
_This article by Carolina Gómez Mena originally appeared in the[May 22, 2026
edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/05/22/politica/denuncian-
tortura-mexicanas-de-la-global-sumud-secuestradas-por-israel-en-su-regreso-a-
mexico), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. After participating in the Global Sumud Flotilla humanitarian
initiative, whose members were intercepted by the israeli government in
international waters, Dr. Violeta Núñez Rodríguez, a professor and researcher
at the Xochimilco Unit of the Metropolitan Autonomous University (UAM), and
activist Sol González Eguía arrived in Mexico and denounced physical and
psychological abuse, as well as various forms of torture, for which they
demanded that President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo break relations with that
country.

Amid chants, music, and demands for justice, which supporters of the pro-
Palestinian movement launched as the activists left through Gate 8 of Terminal
1 of the Mexico City International Airport (AICM), they denounced that Israel
had escalated the violence, and assured that they feared for their lives,
after being victims of multiple mistreatments, many of which do not leave a
mark, but do hurt.

In this regard, Sol González Eguía stated that, unfortunately, the military
under Benjamin Netanyahu's government is overly creative in this area, which
tramples on dignity and human rights. She questioned whether, if the nearly
five hundred participants in the flotilla were subjected to such degrading
treatment, what will they be capable of doing to the Palestinian population
outside of public scrutiny?

Núñez Rodríguez explained that “we were kidnapped in international waters by
the israeli occupation forces and then held for three days and two nights on a
prison ship, we were taken to a prison where we were tortured.”

She detailed that “50 colleagues from the Global Sumud Flotilla are
hospitalized, 35 of them have various fractures, of ribs, legs, shoulders and
arms, 5 people were injected with an unknown liquid and something even more
despicable is that 15 people, so far reported, suffered sexual assaults.”

They announced that they had requested a meeting with Governor Sheinbaum Pardo
to recount their experience and demand the severing of relations with "the
genocidal state of israel."

The academic also indicated that both as a flotilla and personally, they will
file a complaint against israel in international human rights bodies. Both
assured that despite what happened, they will continue to organize flotillas
to deliver humanitarian aid to Palestine.

At the AICM, relatives, friends, activists, and co-workers welcomed the
participants in the humanitarian initiative.
